0fd428315098.learnerContent:
## How the Iran War Is Hurting One of the World's Richest Countries

Qatar is one of the wealthiest nations on Earth, thanks largely to its enormous reserves of natural gas. However, the ongoing conflict involving Iran has dealt a serious blow to the country's economy, disrupting the vital gas exports that Qatar depends on.

### Qatar's Economy and Natural Gas

Qatar is a small country on the Arabian Peninsula, but it punches far above its weight economically. It is one of the world's largest exporters of **liquefied natural gas (LNG)** — natural gas that has been cooled to a liquid form so it can be transported by ship. Countries across Asia and Europe rely on Qatari gas to heat homes, generate electricity, and power industries.

This gas wealth has made Qatar extraordinarily rich. The country has used its revenues to invest in infrastructure, education, and global assets, as well as to fund major events like the 2022 FIFA World Cup.

### The Disruption Caused by the Iran Conflict

Iranian attacks and the broader instability caused by the war have **paralyzed** much of the seaborne transit in the region. "Seaborne transit" refers to the movement of goods by ship across the sea. Because Qatar's LNG must travel by tanker through regional waters, disruptions to shipping lanes have made it extremely difficult to deliver gas to customers abroad.

The stoppage has had immediate and severe consequences. Gas export revenues — the financial backbone of Qatar's economy — have fallen sharply. Contracts with international buyers have been delayed or disrupted, damaging Qatar's reputation as a reliable energy supplier.

### Economic Pivots Put on Hold

In recent years, Qatar had been working to **diversify** its economy — that is, to develop new industries and sources of income so that the country would not be entirely dependent on gas. These efforts included expanding financial services, tourism, and technology sectors.

However, the crisis has **stalled** these plans. When gas revenues decline sharply, the government has less money to invest in new industries. Projects that were meant to anchor the country's long-term growth are now facing delays and uncertainty.

Economists describe this as a particularly painful situation because Qatar was making genuine progress on economic reform before the conflict intensified.

### Regional and Global Implications

Qatar's difficulties are not just a local problem. Because so many countries depend on Qatari gas, any prolonged disruption could lead to energy shortages and higher prices in Europe and Asia. Energy markets around the world are watching the situation closely.

Analysts warn that if the conflict continues, the damage to Qatar's economy could take years to repair — and that the broader regional instability could reshape global energy supply chains in ways that are difficult to predict.

For now, Qatar faces a stark reminder that even the wealthiest nations are not immune to the consequences of war.

## Microsoft Is Removing Teams' Together Mode

Microsoft Teams is a popular app that many people use for video meetings at work or school. During the COVID-19 pandemic, Microsoft introduced a special feature called **Together Mode**. Now, the company has announced it will remove this feature.

### What Was Together Mode?

Together Mode was launched in 2020, when millions of people were working from home. At that time, video calls became a big part of daily work life. The feature used **artificial intelligence (AI)** to cut out each person's head and shoulders from their video and place everyone into a shared virtual background — like a conference room or an auditorium.

The idea was to make meetings feel more natural. Instead of seeing a grid of separate video boxes, everyone appeared to be sitting together in the same space. This could make long meetings feel a little less lonely and also helped reduce visual distractions in the background of people's videos.

### Fun — But Also a Little Strange

Together Mode had some fun interactive elements too. Meeting participants could tap a co-worker on the shoulder or give virtual high fives. However, many users found these features a bit **gimmicky** — meaning they felt more like tricks than truly useful tools. Over time, the novelty wore off for a lot of people.

### Why Is Microsoft Removing It?

The world has changed a lot since the early pandemic days. Many workers have returned to offices, and those who still work from home are more comfortable with standard video calls. Microsoft says it wants to offer a **simpler and cleaner** Teams experience, so it has decided to retire Together Mode.

The removal is being rolled out **gradually**, which means not all users will lose the feature at exactly the same time. Microsoft will phase it out slowly over the coming weeks.

### What Does This Mean for Users?

For most Teams users, the change will probably not be a big problem. Together Mode was always an optional feature, and many people never used it regularly. Standard video calls with individual camera boxes will continue to work exactly as before.

Microsoft continues to add new AI-powered features to Teams, so while Together Mode is leaving, the app is still developing and improving in other areas.

It is always a little surprising when a well-known feature disappears, but this kind of change is normal in the tech world. Products and features come and go as companies learn what users actually need — and what they do not.

b2f04a2e2f4b.learnerContent:
## Apple's New Siri: Privacy as a Selling Point

Apple is preparing a major update to its voice assistant, Siri. According to Bloomberg journalist Mark Gurman, the revamped Siri — expected to debut with **iOS 27** — will function much more like a modern AI chatbot and will include a notable privacy feature: the ability to **automatically delete** conversation histories.

### How Will the New Chat History Feature Work?

Under the new system, users will have control over how long their Siri conversations are stored. The options will reportedly include saving chats for **30 days**, **one year**, or **indefinitely**. Users who prefer maximum privacy will also be able to set their histories to delete automatically.

This stands in stark contrast to most other major AI assistants and chatbots. Competitors such as ChatGPT, Google Gemini, and others typically store conversation data by default, offering only limited "incognito" or temporary chat modes — if they offer any privacy options at all.

### Apple's Privacy Strategy in the AI Race

Apple has long positioned **privacy** as one of its core brand values. However, in the rapidly growing field of generative AI, the company has noticeably lagged behind rivals. While OpenAI, Google, and Meta have been releasing increasingly powerful AI tools, Apple's AI features — marketed under the name **Apple Intelligence** — have faced criticism for being slow to arrive and limited in capability.

By emphasizing privacy controls in its AI products, Apple appears to be making a strategic bet: that a significant number of consumers are **uncomfortable** with how their data is handled by AI systems, and that they would choose a more privacy-conscious option even if it means sacrificing some convenience or capability.

### Why Does This Matter?

Anxiety about AI privacy is genuinely widespread. Many users worry about sensitive conversations being stored on company servers, used to train future AI models, or potentially exposed in data breaches. Apple's approach directly addresses these concerns.

However, there is a trade-off. AI systems often improve their responses by learning from past conversations. By allowing — or encouraging — users to delete their histories, Apple may limit how personalized and context-aware its assistant can become over time.

### What to Expect

The updated Siri is expected to launch alongside iOS 27, which Apple will likely announce at its annual **WWDC** (Worldwide Developers Conference) in June. Whether Apple's privacy-first approach will be enough to win over users who have already grown accustomed to more capable AI assistants from competitors remains to be seen.

For privacy-conscious users, however, this could be a genuinely compelling reason to stay within the Apple ecosystem.

## 'A Girl's Story' Review: A Powerful Debut About a Dark Chapter of Youth

**Director:** Judith Godrèche
**Lead Actress:** Tess Barthélemy
**Based on the novel by:** Annie Ernaux
**Setting:** 1950s France

### A Personal and Assured Debut

"A Girl's Story" is the first feature film directed by Judith Godrèche, a well-known French actress. It is an adaptation of a novel by Annie Ernaux, the celebrated French author who won the Nobel Prize in Literature in 2022. The film tells a bitter and emotionally difficult story about sexual initiation — a young girl's first experience of sexuality — set in France during the 1950s.

Godrèche's debut behind the camera has been described as "assured," meaning she handles the difficult subject matter with confidence and skill. For a first-time director, this is a significant achievement, particularly given the sensitive nature of the story.

### Mother, Daughter, and a Striking Resemblance

One of the most emotionally resonant aspects of the film is its casting. Godrèche's own daughter, Tess Barthélemy, plays the lead role. Critics and audiences have noted a powerful physical resemblance between mother and daughter, which adds an extra layer of meaning to the film.

For viewers who are familiar with Godrèche's own career, this resemblance is especially striking. As a teenager in the early 1990s, Godrèche herself appeared in the French drama "The Disenchanted" (1990), directed by Jacques Doillon. In that film, she played a vulnerable young woman in a way that made her famous. Watching her daughter now perform in a similarly emotionally raw role creates an almost haunting echo between the two generations.

Barthélemy is described as "doe-eyed" — meaning she has large, gentle, expressive eyes — and her performance is said to be luminous, drawing the audience into the story with quiet intensity.

### The Source Material: Annie Ernaux

Annie Ernaux is one of France's most celebrated literary figures. Her writing is often autobiographical, drawing directly from her own memories and experiences. Her work explores themes of class, gender, memory, and female experience in post-war France. The novel on which this film is based deals with a young woman's early sexual experience, told with Ernaux's characteristic honesty and emotional precision.

Adapting such personal and literary material for the screen is a challenge. Godrèche appears to have approached the task with both respect for the source and a clear personal vision.

### Why This Film Matters

Godrèche has spoken publicly in recent years about her own experiences of abuse in the French film industry, making her choice to direct a film about sexual initiation and vulnerability deeply personal. The film arrives at a moment when conversations about consent, power, and the experiences of young women are particularly relevant in both France and globally.

"A Girl's Story" is not an easy film, but it is described as an important one — a work that confronts uncomfortable truths about female experience with artistry and courage.

### Verdict

For audiences interested in literary cinema, French film, or stories about female experience, "A Girl's Story" appears to be a thoughtful and accomplished debut. Godrèche's personal connection to the material, combined with a luminous lead performance from her daughter, makes this a film that is likely to leave a lasting impression.

## Ibeyi Announce New Album: *Offering*

The music duo Ibeyi has officially announced their new album, titled *Offering*. This will be their first full-length album in four years, and it is set to arrive this summer of 2026. Fans of the group have been waiting eagerly for new music, and this announcement has created a lot of excitement.

Ibeyi is a musical duo made up of twin sisters Lisa-Kaindé Diaz and Naomi Diaz. They were born in Paris, France, and have Cuban and French heritage. The word "Ibeyi" means "twins" in Yoruba, a language spoken in West Africa and also connected to Afro-Cuban spiritual traditions.

The title *Offering* suggests themes of giving, spirituality, and connection — ideas that have always been important in Ibeyi's music. ## Trump's Approval Rating Hits New Low, and Ebola Declared a Global Emergency

Two major stories are making headlines this week. First, a new poll shows that U.S. President Donald Trump's approval rating has reached its lowest point ever. Second, health officials have declared a new Ebola outbreak a global health emergency.

### Trump's Approval Rating

An approval rating measures how many people support a political leader. Polling organizations regularly ask citizens questions like, "Do you approve of the job the president is doing?"

According to new data, Trump's approval rating has fallen to a new low. This means fewer Americans are satisfied with his performance as president than at any other time during his term. Approval ratings can drop for many reasons. These include unpopular policies, economic problems, or controversial decisions.

Low approval ratings are important because they can affect a president's ability to pass new laws. Members of Congress often become less willing to support a president when his popularity drops among voters.

### Ebola Declared a Global Health Emergency

Separately, the World Health Organization (WHO) has declared an Ebola outbreak to be a global health emergency. This is a serious official warning. It means the disease is spreading in a way that could affect multiple countries.

Ebola is a dangerous virus. It causes severe illness and can be deadly. It spreads through direct contact with the blood or body fluids of an infected person. Past Ebola outbreaks have killed thousands of people, mainly in parts of Africa.

When the WHO declares a global health emergency, it calls on countries around the world to take action. Governments are asked to strengthen border health checks, share medical resources, and support affected regions.

### Closed-Door Talks Over Greenland

In another developing story, there are reports of private talks happening about Greenland. Greenland is a large island that is officially part of the Kingdom of Denmark. However, it has its own government and a degree of independence.

President Trump has previously expressed interest in the United States acquiring Greenland, due to its strategic location in the Arctic and its natural resources. These latest closed-door discussions suggest that negotiations on this topic may still be continuing, though the details are not yet public.

### Why These Stories Matter

All three of these stories are connected to global power and leadership. A weakened president at home, a deadly disease crossing borders, and quiet negotiations over Arctic territory all point to a world facing significant challenges. ## IMF Upgrades UK Growth Forecast for 2026

The International Monetary Fund (IMF) has raised its growth forecast for the United Kingdom. According to its latest report, the UK economy is now expected to grow by **1%** in 2026. This is an improvement from the previous forecast of **0.8%**.

### What Is the IMF?

The IMF is a powerful international organization that monitors the economies of countries around the world. It regularly publishes forecasts — predictions about how much a country's economy will grow or shrink. These forecasts are closely watched by governments, businesses, and investors because they can influence important financial decisions.

### Why Was the Forecast Upgraded?

The upgrade suggests that the UK economy is performing better than expected. Economic growth means that a country is producing more goods and services than before. When growth increases, it usually means more jobs, higher wages, and better living standards for people.

A rise from 0.8% to 1% may seem small, but in economic terms, even a small change in the growth rate can have a significant impact on millions of people.

### Risks Still Remain

Despite the positive news, the IMF warned that there are still **risks** that could slow down the UK's growth. These risks can come from many places, such as:

- **Global trade tensions** — disagreements between countries about import taxes and trade rules
- **High inflation** — when the prices of goods and services rise faster than people's incomes
- **Political uncertainty** — changes in government policy that make it harder for businesses to plan for the future

The IMF did not give full details about every specific risk, but it made clear that the improved forecast does not mean all problems are solved.

### What Does This Mean for the UK?

For everyday people in the UK, a higher growth forecast can be a positive sign. It may mean that the economy is becoming more stable and that the government will have more money to spend on public services like healthcare and education.

However, economists remind us that forecasts are not guarantees. They are estimates based on current information, and the situation can change quickly depending on events at home and around the world.

### Looking Ahead

The UK government is likely to welcome this upgrade as good news. However, leaders will also need to address the remaining risks carefully to make sure the economy continues to grow steadily.

The IMF will continue to monitor the UK economy and update its forecasts throughout the year. Future reports will show whether the 1% growth target is actually achieved.

## HS2 Failures: What Went Wrong with Britain's High-Speed Rail Project?

A new review has confirmed what many critics have suspected for years: the UK's ambitious high-speed railway project, known as **HS2**, suffered from serious problems right from the very beginning. The report describes these early problems as the project's **"original sins"** — fundamental mistakes that were built into the project before a single track was laid.

### What Is HS2?

HS2, which stands for **High Speed 2**, is a major rail infrastructure project in the United Kingdom. It was originally designed to connect London with cities in the Midlands and the North of England, such as Birmingham, Manchester, and Leeds. The goal was to reduce travel times significantly and ease pressure on existing rail lines.

The project was first approved by the government in 2012 and was seen as one of the most important infrastructure investments in modern British history. However, it has been surrounded by controversy ever since.

### The "Original Sins"

According to the new review, HS2's core problems can be grouped into three main areas:

**1. A Technically Flawed Design**
The original design of the railway prioritized **speed above all else**. While high speed was the central idea of the project, this focus led to an extremely complex and expensive technical design. Building a line capable of very high speeds requires special tunnels, tracks, and safety systems — all of which cost far more than a standard railway.

**2. Changing Political Priorities**
Over the years, different governments made different decisions about HS2. Routes were changed, sections were cancelled, and the overall vision for the project kept shifting. This **political instability** made it very difficult to manage costs and timelines effectively. When governments change their minds frequently, construction planning becomes almost impossible.

**3. Ballooning Costs**
Perhaps the most damaging problem has been the dramatic rise in costs. The original budget for HS2 has **ballooned** — meaning it has grown far beyond what was initially planned. Early estimates suggested the project would cost around £33 billion. In recent years, however, estimates have risen to well over £100 billion, leading to widespread public anger and calls to cancel the project entirely.

In 2023, the government announced that the northern leg of HS2, connecting Birmingham to Manchester, would be **cancelled** due to cost concerns.

### Why Does This Matter?

The HS2 story is an important lesson in large-scale infrastructure planning. When ambitious projects are approved without realistic cost estimates, clear technical planning, or long-term political commitment, they are at serious risk of failure.

Critics argue that billions of pounds of public money have been wasted. Supporters, however, still believe that the completed sections of HS2 will provide long-term economic benefits for the regions they serve.

### Looking Forward

The review's findings are expected to inform how the UK government plans major infrastructure projects in the future. Policymakers will need to ensure that speed, cost, and political stability are carefully balanced from the very start — to avoid repeating the same "original sins."

## A Roommate Nightmare in Los Angeles

In January 2025, Frankee Grove, a 42-year-old woman living in Venice, California, found herself in a difficult situation. She had just broken up with her boyfriend of six years. They had shared a beautiful two-bedroom Spanish-style bungalow together, complete with a vegetable garden, hardwood floors, and a terra-cotta roof. Grove loved living there, but the monthly rent was $5,100 — far too expensive for one person.

At the same time, wildfires were burning across the Pacific Palisades area of Los Angeles. Grove, who worked in education technology and cared deeply about helping others, was volunteering to support people affected by the fires. She had little spare time, but she urgently needed to find a roommate to help pay the rent.

## Finding a Roommate Online

Grove turned to Facebook to search for a subletter — someone who would rent a room in her home. She found a woman named Sabrina Mollison. On social media, Mollison looked like a typical Southern California fitness influencer. She posted workout videos on Instagram, wore expensive athletic clothing, and shared motivational captions like "Trust the process."

Grove had a very different personality. She was more bohemian — she ran a small botanical business, had a surfer-girl hairstyle, and spent summers on Cape Cod in Massachusetts. However, Grove thought their differences might actually be fine. She didn't need a best friend; she just needed someone to share the rent. She was ready for a simple, business-like arrangement.

## Moving In

Mollison came to tour the house wearing workout clothes and heavy makeup. She seemed unimpressed, but agreed to pay $2,200 per month for the spare room. Grove did not ask Mollison to sign a formal lease — she simply accepted a deposit and told her she could move in at the end of January.

When Mollison arrived, she carried all her belongings in black garbage bags. Grove felt uneasy, but she ignored that feeling. She told herself it was just nerves. After settling in, Mollison gave Grove $670 in cash — not enough to cover the first month's rent. Mollison promised to pay the rest by the end of the week.

## Early Warning Signs

A few days later, Grove left for a three-day work trip to New Orleans. When she returned home, she noticed some of her food was missing — a dozen eggs and a bottle of wine. It seemed Mollison had eaten her groceries without permission.

Grove was uncomfortable with direct conflict, so she spoke to Mollison gently. She explained that she preferred to keep their food separate. Mollison responded with a simple "Okay," but seemed distracted and uninterested, as if she wasn't really listening.

Things got worse quickly. One morning, Grove woke up to find Mollison asleep on the living room couch. When Mollison got up and left, Grove saw bright red stains all over the cushions — from Flamin' Hot Cheetos snacks. This was no ordinary sofa. It was a designer midcentury modern couch that had cost $6,600. The damage was a serious problem, and it was clear that the roommate situation was going to become a major nightmare.

## A Spiritual Successor to a Classic RPG

A new video game called *Zero Parades: For Dead Spies* has arrived, and it has a lot in common with one of the most celebrated role-playing games (RPGs) of recent years: *Disco Elysium*. Released in 2019, *Disco Elysium* was widely praised by critics for its deep storytelling, complex characters, and unique style. Now, *Zero Parades* is trying to follow in its footsteps — though it cannot fully escape comparisons to its famous inspiration.

## The Story of Cascade

In *Zero Parades*, players take on the role of a spy named Cascade. She led a team of agents on an important mission, but the operation failed badly. As a result, Cascade not only let down her fellow spies professionally — she also hurt people she considered close friends.

As a punishment, Cascade is "frozen" — taken off active fieldwork and forced to sit at a desk for five years. This is a painful experience for someone who is used to being in the middle of the action. However, after those five years pass, Cascade is given a second chance. She is sent to a city called Portofiro with a new assignment. This is her opportunity to redeem herself — to prove that she is still a capable spy and to repair the relationships she damaged.

At its heart, the game asks a difficult question: **What is the true price of forgiveness?** Cascade is willing to sacrifice almost anything to reconnect with the people she let down. But can she really make things right after such a serious failure?

## Similar to Disco Elysium

*Zero Parades* is being called a "spiritual successor" to *Disco Elysium*. This means it is not a direct sequel, but it was clearly inspired by the earlier game and shares many of the same ideas and design choices.

*Disco Elysium* told the story of a troubled detective who was dealing with deep emotional pain and a severe hangover. The game split his mind into many different voices that players could interact with, making choices that reflected different parts of his personality.

*Zero Parades* appears to borrow heavily from this style. Like *Disco Elysium*, it focuses on a protagonist who is struggling with past mistakes and trying to find a path forward. The game's themes of guilt, redemption, and forgiveness are very similar.

## Can It Stand on Its Own?

The big challenge for *Zero Parades* is that *Disco Elysium* left a very large shadow. Fans of the original game may notice many similarities and wonder if the new game is too close to its inspiration. Critics will likely ask whether *Zero Parades* brings enough new ideas to stand on its own, or whether it is simply trying to recreate the magic of a beloved classic.

For players who enjoy story-rich RPGs with complex moral questions and interesting characters, *Zero Parades: For Dead Spies* looks like a promising — if familiar — experience.

## Brazil Uses Films, TV, and Games to Attract Tourists

Brazil's national tourism board, **Embratur**, has announced a new plan to bring more visitors to the country. The plan has eight different parts, and it focuses on a growing trend called **audiovisual-inspired tourism** — when people travel to a place because they saw it in a movie, TV show, or video game.

### Why Does Screen Tourism Matter?

Research shows that around **90 million people** around the world choose their holiday destinations based on what they have seen on screen. This is a huge number, and it shows how powerful films and TV shows can be for a country's tourism industry.

A well-known example is **Dubrovnik, Croatia**. This beautiful coastal city became extremely popular with tourists after it appeared as a filming location in the TV series *Game of Thrones*. The city has struggled to manage the large number of visitors ever since. Brazil hopes to create a similar effect — but in a more organized and sustainable way.

### Brazil's Eight-Part Strategy

Embratur's eight-pronged strategy covers several areas. The plan includes promoting Brazilian locations to international film and TV production companies, encouraging them to shoot their projects in Brazil. When a popular show or movie features a Brazilian city, beach, or landmark, it naturally makes viewers around the world curious about visiting.

The strategy also focuses on **digital games**. Online and video games are increasingly popular worldwide, and games set in real or realistic locations can inspire players to visit those places in real life. Brazil wants to work with game developers to feature Brazilian landscapes and culture in their games.

Another part of the strategy involves working with streaming platforms. With services like Netflix and Amazon Prime producing more international content, Brazil sees a strong opportunity to get its locations seen by global audiences.

### Brazil Has a Lot to Offer

Brazil is already famous for its stunning natural scenery, including the **Amazon rainforest**, the **Pantanal wetlands**, and beautiful coastlines with iconic beaches like Copacabana and Ipanema in Rio de Janeiro. The country also has vibrant cities, rich cultural traditions, and world-famous events like the **Rio Carnival**.

However, Brazil has sometimes been underrepresented in global media compared to other popular tourist destinations. Embratur believes that by getting more films, series, and games to feature Brazilian settings, the country can reach new audiences and change perceptions.

### A Global Trend

Brazil is not alone in using this approach. Countries like **New Zealand** (famous after *The Lord of the Rings*) and **South Korea** (boosted by the global success of K-dramas and films like *Parasite*) have seen enormous tourism growth linked to their screen presence.

Experts call this "screen tourism" or "set-jetting," and it is one of the fastest-growing segments in the global travel industry. Travel agencies report that more and more clients ask specifically to visit places they recognized from a show or film.

### Looking Ahead

Embratur's new strategy shows that Brazil is serious about competing in the global tourism market. By connecting entertainment and travel, the country hopes to welcome millions of new visitors in the coming years — people who first fell in love with Brazil from their sofas, and then decided to see it for themselves.

## Films du Losange to Handle International Sales for Lola Quivoron's 'El Dorado'

Paris-based distribution company **Films du Losange** has announced that it will manage international sales for *El Dorado*, a new psychological thriller directed by French filmmaker **Lola Quivoron**. Production on the film has recently wrapped in the south of France.

### The Film and Its Cast

*El Dorado* brings together a strong ensemble cast. The film stars **Matthias Schoenaerts**, the acclaimed Belgian actor known for his intense screen presence in films such as *Rust and Bone* and *A Bigger Splash*. He is joined by **Mallory Wanecque**, **Antonia Buresi**, and **Samuel Kircher**, all of whom are notable names in contemporary French and European cinema.

As a psychological thriller, *El Dorado* is expected to explore themes of tension, identity, and perhaps obsession — though full plot details have not yet been officially released.

### Quivoron's Rising Profile

*El Dorado* is Lola Quivoron's **sophomore feature**, meaning it is her second full-length film as a director. Her debut, *Rodeo* (2022), announced her as one of the most exciting new voices in French cinema. *Rodeo* world-premiered in the prestigious **Un Certain Regard** section at the **Cannes Film Festival**, one of the most respected sidebars of the world's most famous film event. The film went on to win an award there, further cementing Quivoron's reputation.

*Rodeo* followed a young woman who becomes involved in the underground world of motorbike stunt riding. It was praised for its raw energy, strong lead performance, and confident direction. Critics and industry insiders took notice, and expectations for Quivoron's follow-up have been high ever since.

### Films du Losange: A Respected Partner

**Films du Losange** is one of France's most prestigious independent film companies. Founded in 1962, it has a long history of working with major European auteurs, including **Éric Rohmer** and **Michael Haneke**. The company is known for championing serious, artistically ambitious films and bringing them to international audiences.

By partnering with Films du Losange for international sales, *El Dorado* is positioning itself as a film with serious festival ambitions. It would not be surprising to see the film submitted for consideration at major festivals such as Cannes, Venice, or Berlin in the near future.

### Southern France as a Backdrop

The decision to film in **southern France** gives *El Dorado* a visually distinctive setting. The region — which includes areas such as Provence, the Camargue, and the Mediterranean coastline — is known for its dramatic landscapes, strong light, and a certain atmosphere that filmmakers have long found compelling. Directors from Jean-Luc Godard to Jacques Audiard have used the south of France to striking effect.

### What to Watch For

With a respected sales agent now on board, *El Dorado* is likely to generate significant attention in the international film market. Buyers and festival programmers will be watching closely, given the combination of Quivoron's promising track record, a recognizable lead actor in Schoenaerts, and the backing of Films du Losange.

For fans of European arthouse cinema and psychological thrillers, *El Dorado* is shaping up to be one of the more anticipated French films of the coming season.

## The Smashing Pumpkins Announce the Rats in a Cage Tour

The Smashing Pumpkins, one of the most iconic rock bands of the 1990s, have announced a brand new concert tour called the **Rats in a Cage Tour**. The announcement was made by the band's leader, Billy Corgan, along with his fellow band members.

### Two Unique Sets Every Night

One of the most exciting parts of this tour is that the band has promised to play "two unique sets" at each show. This means that fans who attend a concert will hear two separate groups of songs in one night, with each set featuring a different selection of music.

This kind of format is special because it gives the audience more variety and value for their ticket. Many bands simply play the same list of songs every night on tour, so offering two different sets makes each show feel more like a unique event.

### Who Are the Smashing Pumpkins?

The Smashing Pumpkins are an American rock band that was formed in Chicago, Illinois in 1988. Billy Corgan is the founder, lead singer, and main songwriter of the group. The band became hugely popular in the 1990s with albums like *Siamese Dream* (1993) and *Mellon Collie and the Infinite Sadness* (1995).

Their music is known for mixing loud, heavy guitar sounds with softer, more emotional melodies. Songs like "Bullet with Butterfly Wings," "1979," and "Tonight, Tonight" are considered rock classics. The band has sold tens of millions of albums worldwide and has influenced many other artists.

The tour name, "Rats in a Cage," is a reference to one of their most famous songs, "Bullet with Butterfly Wings," which includes the well-known lyric: *"Despite all my rage, I am still just a rat in a cage."* Using this phrase as the tour name is a nod to the band's history and their most loyal fans.

### What to Expect

For fans of the Smashing Pumpkins, this tour is a major event. The promise of two unique sets per show suggests that the band may dig deep into their large catalog of music, possibly playing both well-known hits and rare or older songs that they do not usually perform live.

Further details about the tour, such as specific cities, dates, and ticket prices, are expected to be announced soon. Fans are encouraged to follow the band's official channels for updates.

Whether you are a long-time fan or someone just discovering their music, the Rats in a Cage Tour looks like it will be a memorable live experience.

## Trump Warns Iran: "The Clock Is Ticking"

**Washington D.C. / Middle East — May 2025**

US President Donald Trump has sent a strong warning to Iran, saying that the country must reach a peace deal soon or face serious consequences. "The clock is ticking," Trump said. He added that there "won't be anything left" of Iran if it does not come to an agreement with the United States.

This warning comes at a time of growing tension in the Middle East. Iran and the United States have had difficult relations for many years, and recent events have made the situation worse.

## Drone Strike Near a Nuclear Plant

The United Arab Emirates (UAE) has accused Iran of carrying out a dangerous drone strike near a nuclear facility on UAE territory. A drone strike means an attack using unmanned aircraft. The UAE said that Iran, or groups working for Iran (called "proxies"), were responsible for the fire caused by the attack.

Attacks near nuclear plants are considered extremely dangerous because they can cause radiation leaks that affect the health of millions of people across the region. A nuclear facility is a place where nuclear energy is produced or where nuclear materials are stored.

## Germany Speaks Out

German Chancellor Friedrich Merz strongly criticized the Iranian airstrikes in a statement posted on his social media account. He wrote:

> "We strongly condemn the renewed Iranian airstrikes against the United Arab Emirates and other partners. Attacks on nuclear facilities pose a threat to the safety of people throughout the entire region. There must be no further escalation of violence."

Merz also called on Iran to take three specific steps:
1. Enter into serious negotiations with the United States.
2. Stop threatening its neighboring countries.
3. Open the Strait of Hormuz without restrictions.

## Why Is the Strait of Hormuz Important?

The Strait of Hormuz is a narrow waterway located between Iran and the Arabian Peninsula. It is one of the most important shipping routes in the world. A large percentage of the world's oil travels through this strait every day. If Iran blocks or restricts this waterway, it can cause major problems for the global economy, raising fuel and energy prices worldwide.

Iran has previously threatened to close the Strait of Hormuz during periods of tension with Western countries.

## What Happens Next?

The situation in the Middle East remains very unstable. International leaders are calling for calm and diplomacy — meaning they want countries to talk and negotiate instead of using military force.

The key questions now are:
- Will Iran agree to begin peace talks with the United States?
- Will the attacks in the region stop?
- Can diplomats from different countries find a solution before the situation gets worse?

The world is watching closely as leaders try to prevent further violence in an already fragile region.

## 'Hope' Director Na Hong-jin Confirms a Sequel Is Already Written

Korean director Na Hong-jin made a big announcement at the Cannes Film Festival this week. His new film, *Hope*, had its premiere on Sunday night and immediately became one of the most talked-about movies at the festival. The very next day, at a press conference on Monday, Na Hong-jin revealed that a sequel is already being planned — and the script has already been written.

"I think you can readily imagine this sequel," the director told journalists. "There's a script that's already been done that I'd like to move forward with." This surprised many people, as the first film had only just been shown to the public for the first time.

### What Is 'Hope' About?

*Hope* is being described as an alien action epic — a big, exciting science fiction film full of action and surprises. It is directed by Na Hong-jin, who is well known for his intense and creative Korean films, such as *The Wailing* (2016). *Hope* is a major step in a new direction for him, combining a large international cast with a bold science fiction story.

The film stars two very famous Hollywood actors: Michael Fassbender and Alicia Vikander. Interestingly, both of them play aliens in the movie. This is an unusual and exciting choice, and many viewers at Cannes were curious about why these well-known human actors were chosen to portray non-human characters.

### Why Did Fassbender and Vikander Play Aliens?

Both actors spoke at the Cannes press conference about their decision to join the film. Playing an alien is a unique challenge for any actor. They must think carefully about how to move, speak, and express emotion in a way that feels different from a normal human being — but still interesting and believable to the audience.

Fassbender and Vikander are both experienced actors who have taken on many different types of roles in their careers. Fassbender is known for films like the *X-Men* series and *Steve Jobs*, while Vikander won an Academy Award for her role in *The Danish Girl*. Taking on alien roles in a Korean director's science fiction film shows that both actors are willing to try bold and creative projects.

### A Big Night at Cannes

The Cannes Film Festival, held every year in the south of France, is one of the most important film festivals in the world. It is a place where filmmakers show their newest and most ambitious work to critics, journalists, and industry professionals from around the globe.

*Hope* was clearly one of the highlights of this year's festival. Audiences reacted strongly to the film, and it quickly became the subject of many conversations and reviews. Films that make a strong impression at Cannes often go on to receive wide international releases and awards attention.

### What's Next?

With a sequel script already completed, it seems like Na Hong-jin has a clear vision for the future of the *Hope* story. If the first film performs well with general audiences after its wider release, production on the second film could begin relatively quickly.

For now, film fans around the world are eagerly waiting to see *Hope* for themselves — and wondering what surprises the sequel might bring.

## MAHA Supporters Grow Frustrated with Trump

The "Make America Healthy Again" movement, known as MAHA, was once one of Donald Trump's most enthusiastic support groups. However, a series of policy decisions and broken promises has left many MAHA supporters feeling deeply disappointed in the former president and current political figure.

### What Is MAHA?

MAHA is a political and health-focused movement that grew alongside Trump's broader MAGA (Make America Great Again) base. MAHA supporters tend to focus on issues like food safety, public health, and reducing the influence of large pharmaceutical and food companies. Many of them backed Trump because they believed he would challenge powerful industries that they think harm public health.

### A Feeling of Betrayal

According to reports, MAHA supporters feel that Trump has repeatedly let them down. They use the word "betrayal" to describe moments when Trump sided with the very industries or political interests that MAHA opposes. For example, supporters expected Trump to take strong action against certain food additives and pharmaceutical companies, but many feel he has not followed through on those expectations.

When a political leader does not keep his or her promises, supporters can feel betrayed. This feeling is especially strong when people believed deeply in that leader and worked hard to help him gain power.

### Why This Matters

Political movements need loyal supporters to stay strong. When key groups within a coalition — a group of allies working together — begin to lose faith, it can weaken the overall movement. MAHA represents a vocal and active part of Trump's base, so their growing frustration is politically significant.

Some MAHA figures have begun to speak out publicly, criticizing Trump's choices on social media and in interviews. This kind of open criticism from former allies is unusual and shows how serious the disappointment has become.

### A Pattern of Broken Promises?

MAHA supporters point to what they call a "series" of betrayals — meaning not just one incident, but several over time. Each new disappointment adds to the frustration. Political analysts suggest that this pattern could signal a broader weakening of Trump's coalition as different groups within it begin to question his leadership.

For now, it remains to be seen whether MAHA supporters will fully break away from Trump or simply push him to change course. Either way, the tension highlights the challenges of keeping a large and diverse political movement united over time.

## Iran War Threat Exposes Deep Divisions Within MAGA

The prospect of military conflict with Iran has brought to the surface significant internal divisions within the MAGA (Make America Great Again) movement. What was once presented as a unified political force is now showing signs of ideological fracture, particularly over questions of foreign policy and military intervention.

### The Core Tension

At the heart of the dispute is a longstanding tension between two competing visions within the American right. On one side are **non-interventionists** — sometimes called isolationists — who believe the United States should avoid foreign wars and focus on domestic priorities. On the other side are **hawkish conservatives** who favor a more aggressive posture toward adversaries like Iran, arguing that military strength and deterrence are essential to national security.

Trump himself has historically appealed to both camps, presenting himself as a deal-maker who avoids "endless wars" while simultaneously threatening military force against rivals. This ambiguity has allowed him to hold the coalition together — until now.

### Iran as a Flashpoint

Rising tensions with Iran have forced MAGA figures to take more explicit positions. Prominent voices within the movement have clashed publicly over whether a military strike or even full-scale war with Iran would be justified, strategically sound, or consistent with MAGA's stated principles.

Non-interventionist commentators and politicians have warned that engaging in another Middle Eastern war would repeat the costly mistakes of Iraq and Afghanistan — conflicts that many MAGA supporters originally opposed. They argue that such a war would contradict Trump's own "America First" doctrine, which prioritizes withdrawing from foreign entanglements.

Howkish figures, by contrast, frame Iran as an existential threat that must be confronted directly. They argue that weakness invites aggression and that a decisive military response would strengthen American credibility on the world stage.

### A Movement Under Strain

The public nature of these disagreements is itself notable. Political movements typically try to manage internal disputes behind closed doors, presenting a united front to the public. The fact that prominent MAGA figures are openly contradicting one another on such a fundamental issue as war and peace suggests that the coalition is under serious strain.

Analysts note that these rifts are not entirely new — they reflect longstanding tensions within American conservatism between nationalist restraint and neoconservative interventionism. However, the immediacy of a potential conflict with Iran has given these abstract disagreements a sharp, urgent edge.

### What Comes Next?

How Trump navigates this divide will be closely watched. Siding too firmly with hawks risks alienating a significant portion of his base that voted for him precisely because he promised fewer foreign wars. Leaning too far toward restraint, on the other hand, could be portrayed by opponents as weakness.

The Iran situation has, in effect, become a political test — one that reveals not just differing views on foreign policy, but deeper questions about what the MAGA movement actually stands for.

## The Strait of Hormuz: Why It Matters for Oil and Shipping

The Strait of Hormuz is one of the most important waterways in the world. It is a narrow passage of water located between Iran and Oman, connecting the Persian Gulf to the Arabian Sea. About 20% of the world's oil supply passes through this strait every day, making it extremely important for global energy markets.

**Why Is the Strait in the News?**

Recently, there have been serious concerns about whether ships can safely travel through the Strait of Hormuz. Tensions in the region have disrupted normal shipping traffic. When a key shipping route like this one is blocked or becomes dangerous, it affects the entire world — not just the countries nearby.

Right now, it is still unclear when normal shipping will fully resume. No formal agreement has been reached between the parties involved, which means there is no official plan to guarantee safe passage for ships.

**What Happens When the Strait Is Blocked?**

When ships cannot pass through the Strait of Hormuz freely, oil cannot be delivered on time to countries around the world. This causes oil supplies to fall short of demand, which pushes oil prices higher. Higher oil prices affect many things in daily life — from the cost of gasoline to the prices of goods in stores, because trucks and ships need fuel to transport products.

Oil-importing countries, especially in Asia and Europe, are watching the situation very closely. Countries like Japan, South Korea, China, and India depend heavily on oil from the Persian Gulf region.

**What Do Experts Say?**

Analysts say that without a clear and formal agreement, it is very difficult to predict when things will return to normal. Even if both sides agree to reopen the strait, it may take time before shipping companies feel confident enough to send their vessels through.

Until a solid deal is in place, oil prices are likely to remain high or even increase further. Markets do not like uncertainty — when traders are unsure about future oil supply, they often push prices up as a precaution.

**The Bigger Picture**

The situation around the Strait of Hormuz reminds us how connected the global economy is. A problem in one small region of the world can quickly raise the price of fuel, food, and goods everywhere else. Governments and businesses around the world are hoping for a quick and peaceful resolution so that normal trade can resume as soon as possible.

## 'Mandalorian and Grogu' Opens at Number One

The new movie *The Mandalorian and Grogu* opened at the top of the box office in the United States. Disney made this film as part of its plan to bring the *Star Wars* series back to its former glory.

**How Much Did the Movie Make?**

The movie was expected to earn about $102 million at domestic theaters from Thursday to Monday — a five-day period that includes the Memorial Day holiday weekend in the US. This is a strong opening for any film, and Disney is very happy with the early results.

However, the movie was also very expensive to make. Disney spent $300 million to produce and market the film. That means the studio needs to earn a lot of money — both in cinemas and later on streaming and home video — to make a profit.

**What Is the Movie About?**

*The Mandalorian and Grogu* is based on the very popular Disney+ television series *The Mandalorian*. The show first appeared in 2019 and quickly became a fan favorite. It follows a lone warrior called the Mandalorian, and a small, cute, and powerful creature known as Grogu — often called "Baby Yoda" by fans.

The TV series was one of the first big successes for the Disney+ streaming platform. Now, Disney is bringing these beloved characters to the big screen for the first time.

**Why Is This Important for Disney?**

In recent years, the *Star Wars* brand had some problems. Several *Star Wars* movies and TV shows did not do as well as Disney had hoped. Some fans were unhappy with the direction of the stories.

Disney is now trying a new strategy. Instead of making completely new *Star Wars* stories, the company is focusing on characters that fans already love. *The Mandalorian* and Grogu are some of the most popular characters in the *Star Wars* universe today.

**A Big Bet for Disney**

Spending $300 million on one movie is a very big risk. But Disney believes that the love fans have for Grogu and the Mandalorian can bring large audiences to cinemas. If this movie does well, we can expect more *Star Wars* films featuring these characters in the future.

## *On Trails* — A Book That Goes Far Beyond Hiking

For many people, hiking is one of life's greatest pleasures. Leaving behind screens and daily routines to spend time in nature — sometimes for several days at a stretch — can feel deeply refreshing and restorative. Whether it is a short walk through a local park or a multi-day trek along a famous long-distance trail, moving through the natural world on foot has a way of clearing the mind.

### A Reader Who Can No Longer Hike

The reviewer who wrote about *On Trails: An Exploration* by Robert Moor admits that backpacking is no longer possible for them personally. With two young children and a troublesome back, extended hiking trips are off the table. Instead, they satisfy their love of the outdoors by reading accounts written by people who have completed long, demanding hikes — particularly along famous American trails like the Appalachian Trail (AT) or the Pacific Crest Trail (PCT).

The Appalachian Trail stretches approximately 3,500 kilometers from Georgia to Maine along the eastern United States, while the Pacific Crest Trail runs nearly 4,300 kilometers from the Mexican border to Canada along the west coast. Both trails are iconic challenges that attract thousands of "thru-hikers" — people who attempt to walk the entire length in a single journey — every year.

### More Than a Hiking Memoir

When the reviewer picked up *On Trails*, they expected a traditional hiking memoir: a personal story about the physical and emotional challenges of completing a long-distance trail. The book does begin this way, with author Robert Moor describing his decision to thru-hike the Appalachian Trail.

However, the book quickly reveals itself to be something far more ambitious. Rather than simply recounting his own hiking experience, Moor uses trails as a lens through which to explore much broader questions. He examines the history and science behind trails — how they are formed, why animals and humans create them, and what they reveal about intelligence, behavior, and civilization.

### Why Trails Matter

Trails are easy to take for granted. We walk along them without thinking about how they came to exist or what they represent. But Moor argues that trails are a fundamental part of life on Earth. Animals create trails through repeated movement, gradually wearing paths through forests and across mountains. Early humans followed animal trails, and those paths eventually became roads, and then cities.

In this sense, trails are not just convenient routes through nature — they are a record of how living creatures interact with their environment and with each other over time.

### A Book for Curious Readers

*On Trails* blends personal narrative, natural history, and scientific inquiry in a way that is engaging and thought-provoking. It is likely to appeal to readers who enjoy books that use a single, seemingly simple subject as a starting point to explore much bigger ideas.

Whether you are an enthusiastic hiker, someone who simply enjoys being outdoors, or a reader who is curious about the hidden patterns and histories that shape the world around us, *On Trails* appears to offer something genuinely rewarding. It is the kind of book that changes how you see the landscape beneath your feet — even if you are reading it from the comfort of your own home.

## *Passenger* — A Scary Road Trip You Won't Forget

**What is the movie about?**

*Passenger* is a new horror film directed by Norwegian filmmaker André Øvredal. The story takes place on the highways of America, where a mysterious and dangerous figure follows and attacks drivers. The movie turns something very ordinary — driving a car — into something deeply frightening.

**Everyday life becomes scary**

One of the smartest things a horror film can do is take a normal, familiar situation and make it feel dangerous. Most people drive every day without thinking about it. They listen to the radio, follow the road signs, and enjoy the journey. In *Passenger*, all of these familiar sights and sounds slowly become signs that something terrible is about to happen. The ordinary world becomes a place full of danger.

**Who made this film?**

André Øvredal is a director from Norway who is well known for making scary movies. Some of his earlier works include *Trollhunter* and *Scary Stories to Tell in the Dark*. He has a talent for building tension slowly and making audiences feel uneasy without relying only on sudden shocks.

With *Passenger*, Øvredal does not try to completely change the horror genre or do something no one has ever seen before. Instead, he takes a classic idea — a killer on the road — and executes it with great skill and style. Critics say the film is "stylish" and "satisfying," which means it looks great and delivers exactly what horror fans are hoping for.

**Why road horror works so well**

Road horror is a popular type of scary movie because highways and long drives create a special kind of fear. When you are driving, you are often alone, far from help, and moving through unfamiliar places. If something goes wrong, it can be very difficult to escape. Films like *Duel* (1971) and *Joy Ride* (2001) have used this setting successfully in the past. *Passenger* continues this tradition.

The sounds of driving — the hum of the engine, the noise of the tires on the road, the click of a turn signal — are things we usually find comforting. In *Passenger*, these same sounds are used to create fear and tension. This is a clever trick that makes the horror feel very real and personal.

**What do critics say?**

Early reviews of *Passenger* are positive. Critics describe it as a "thrill-ride" — an exciting experience that keeps you on the edge of your seat. The film is praised for its clean, stylish visuals and its ability to build suspense effectively. While it may not be the most original horror film ever made, it is considered a well-crafted and highly enjoyable entry in the genre.

For fans of horror movies who enjoy stories about danger on the open road, *Passenger* appears to be a strong choice. It shows that a familiar idea, handled with care and confidence, can still produce something truly entertaining and frightening.

## *Obsession*: How a Low-Budget Horror Film Became a Box Office Sensation

**A remarkable rise at the box office**

The horror film *Obsession* has become one of the most talked-about success stories at the box office this year. In its second weekend of release, the low-budget film earned $22 million from 2,655 North American theaters — a result that has surprised many industry observers. When the Memorial Day holiday weekend figures are included, projected earnings rise to an impressive $28.2 million.

What makes these numbers especially striking is that they represent a 30% increase over the film's opening weekend, when it earned $17.2 million from 2,615 cinemas. In Hollywood, it is very common for films to lose a large portion of their audience after the first weekend. A significant increase in the second weekend is rare and signals something unusual: genuine word-of-mouth momentum.

**Why second-weekend growth matters**

In the film industry, the performance drop between a movie's opening weekend and its second weekend is closely watched. Most blockbusters lose between 40% and 60% of their audience in week two. A film that actually grows its audience — especially by 30% — is demonstrating that regular moviegoers are recommending it enthusiastically to friends and family.

This kind of organic audience growth is particularly valuable for a low-budget production because it means the film is generating profit far beyond what its modest production costs would typically allow. When a small film earns big-budget numbers, the return on investment becomes extraordinary.

**The economics of low-budget horror**

Horror has long been one of Hollywood's most reliable genres for generating profit from a small investment. Unlike large-scale action or science fiction films, which can cost hundreds of millions of dollars to produce, horror movies are often made for a fraction of that amount. *Obsession* appears to be a textbook example of this model working at its best.

Because the film's production budget was low, it did not need to earn enormous sums to be considered profitable. With ticket sales already well above typical expectations for a film of its size, *Obsession* is on track to become one of the most financially successful movies of 2026 relative to its budget.

**Memorial Day and the holiday boost**

The Memorial Day holiday weekend in the United States — typically falling at the end of May — is one of the most important periods in the cinema calendar. Families and friends have time off work and school, and many choose to spend it at the movies. A strong Memorial Day performance can significantly extend a film's overall theatrical run and boost its final earnings.

For *Obsession*, the holiday timing appears to have provided an additional lift at exactly the right moment, helping to push its second-weekend figures even higher.

**Looking ahead**

With this level of momentum, *Obsession* is expected to continue performing well in the coming weeks. Its success is a reminder that audiences still have a strong appetite for well-made horror, and that a compelling story does not require a massive budget to find a large and enthusiastic audience.

## Drake Makes Music History on the Billboard 200

Drake has become the first artist in history to hold the top three positions on the Billboard 200 chart at the same time. This is an amazing achievement that no other musician has ever accomplished before.

### The Three Songs

The three songs that reached the top three spots are **"Iceman,"** **"Habibti,"** and **"Maid of Honour."** All three tracks entered the chart and climbed to the very top positions simultaneously, which is incredibly rare in the music industry.

### What Is the Billboard 200?

The Billboard 200 is one of the most important music charts in the United States. It ranks the most popular albums and songs based on sales, streaming numbers, and radio plays each week. Reaching number one on this chart is a huge goal for any artist. Holding the top three spots at the same time is something that has never happened before — until now.

### Drake's Long Career

Drake, whose full name is Aubrey Drake Graham, is a Canadian rapper, singer, and songwriter. He was born in Toronto, Canada, in 1986. He first became famous with his mixtapes in the late 2000s and then released his debut studio album *Thank Me Later* in 2010.

Since then, Drake has become one of the best-selling music artists in the world. He is known for mixing rap and R&B styles in his music. Over the years, he has broken many Billboard records. For example, he has previously held the record for the most entries on the Hot 100 chart by a single artist.

### Why This Record Is Special

Having one song at number one on the Billboard 200 is already a great achievement. Having two songs in the top positions at the same time is even rarer. But holding **all three** of the top spots at once is something that no artist — not even legends like Michael Jackson, The Beatles, or Taylor Swift — had ever done before Drake.

This new record shows just how popular Drake is right now. It also shows how much streaming services like Spotify and Apple Music have changed the music industry. In the past, fans had to buy physical albums or download songs to push an artist up the charts. Today, simply playing a song many times on a streaming platform can help it rise quickly.

### Reactions

Fans and music journalists around the world have been talking about this historic moment. Many people on social media congratulated Drake on the achievement. Music critics have noted that this kind of dominance on a major chart is almost impossible to achieve, which makes it even more impressive.

## Rob Base, Rapper Known for "It Takes Two," Dies at 59

Rob Base, a famous rapper from the United States, has died at the age of 59. He had been sick with cancer before he passed away.

### Who Was Rob Base?

Rob Base was a rapper from **Harlem**, a neighborhood in New York City. His real name was Robert Ginyard. He grew up in Harlem and started making music there as a young man.

He was one-half of a music duo called **Rob Base & DJ E-Z Rock**. A duo is a group of two people. His partner was DJ E-Z Rock, whose real name was Rodney Stone.

### "It Takes Two"

Rob Base is best known for the song **"It Takes Two."** This song came out in **1988** and became a very big hit. People all over the world loved it. The song has a fun, energetic beat and is easy to dance to.

Even today, many people still know "It Takes Two." It has been used in movies, TV shows, and commercials for many years. It is one of the most famous hip-hop songs ever made.

The title "It Takes Two" means that you need two people to do something together. In the song, Rob Base and DJ E-Z Rock celebrate working as a team.

### Hip-Hop in the 1980s

Rob Base started making music during a very exciting time for hip-hop. In the 1980s, hip-hop was a new and growing style of music. It started in New York City, especially in neighborhoods like Harlem and the Bronx.

Artists like Rob Base helped make hip-hop popular around the world. They showed that this new style of music was fun, creative, and full of energy.

### Remembering Rob Base

Fans and other musicians are very sad about the news of his death. Many people have shared their memories of "It Takes Two" on social media. The song made people happy for almost 40 years, and it will continue to do so.

Rob Base leaves behind an important legacy in music history. A **legacy** is something that a person leaves behind after they die — like great music that people never forget.

He was 59 years old.
